labels.name: Osteochondroma
labels.function: Most common benign bone tumor; multiple in EXT1/EXT2 syndrome

labels.name: Cartilage cap
labels.function: Covers the exostosis tip; often invisible on x-ray, seen on MRI

labels.name: Osteoid osteoma
labels.function: Under 2 cm with lucent core; night pain relieved by NSAIDs

labels.name: Codman triangle
labels.function: Periosteum lifted at the tumor margin; classic sarcoma sign

labels.name: Osteosarcoma
labels.function: Most common primary malignant bone tumor; sunburst pattern

labels.name: Chondroblastoma
labels.function: Teen epiphysis; chicken-wire calcification; curettage + graft

labels.name: Ewing sarcoma
labels.function: Boys under 15; onion-skin periosteal layers; t(11;22)

labels.name: Enchondroma
labels.function: Medullary hyaline cartilage nodule; IDH1/IDH2 mutations

labels.name: Giant cell tumor of bone
labels.function: Adult soap-bubble lysis driven by stromal RANKL

labels.name: Metastatic tumor cell
labels.function: Reaches bone by blood, lymph, direct extension or spinal seeding

labels.name: PTHrP
labels.function: Hormone-like tumor product that upregulates bone resorption

labels.name: TGF-beta
labels.function: Growth factor that also drives resorption in the lytic pattern

labels.name: Osteolytic lesion
labels.function: Small holes that weaken bone and invite pathologic fracture

labels.name: Endothelin-1
labels.function: Growth factor released by tumor cells in the sclerotic pattern

labels.name: Osteoblast
labels.function: Bone-forming cell driven by tumor-derived growth factors

labels.name: Osteoblastic lesion
labels.function: Excess bony matrix; bone looks denser on imaging
